overview: Session 15 is the short run of production: capital is fixed and the only choice is how much labor to use. You learn the production function, then the three productivity measures computed from it (total, average and marginal product), the pattern of increasing, diminishing and negative marginal returns, and the hiring rule VMP = wage. The session ends with the three algebraic forms (linear, Leontief, Cobb-Douglas) and how they differ in substitutability. Production is about a quarter of Midterm 2, and the professor lists the profit-maximizing input calculation first among the things he will ask. VMP and the hiring rule are not on the equation sheet, so they must be memorized; MP, AP and the Cobb-Douglas marginal products are on it.
